dialogue, cooperation and practical action.European Leaders for Growth and CompetitivenessThis high-level group advises action on the finance, energy, technology and trade drivers of European growth and competitiveness.Global Alliance for Trade FacilitationThis initiative helps streamline trade processes to make them faster, cheaper and more effective.Humanitarian & Resilience Investing Against Forced LabourThis initiative aims to accelerate systems-level efforts to combat forced labour by developing technology tools to scale data sharing, while inspiring new approaches towards action.Our impactWe work with partners across sectors to respond to shifting geopolitical dynamics and support more open, stable and resilient economies.A decade of impactThe Global Alliance for Trade Facilitation (GATF) has generated over $200 million in trade cost savings – an average 240% return on investment – through 36 projects in more than 20 countries.TradeTech improves trade transparencyThe TradeTech initiative encourages trade facilitation by improving transparency, fostering inter-agency cooperation and enabling data sharing for more effective risk management.Top Ghana, Kenya, and India to help tackle shortfalls in sustainable foreign direct investment (FDI).Join our work on regions, trade and geopoliticsWe believe multistakeholder dialogue and cooperation underpin the ability to achieve progress on shared priorities. The Centre partners with governments, business, civil society groups and international organizations to generate insight and deliver cooperative solutions to issues of global and regional concern. Be part of this work and join our community.World Economic Forum CentresThe world is confronted with a range of unprecedented challenges.
